title: CHASE COLEMAN'S TIGER GLOBAL JUST UPDATED ITS STOCK PORTFOLIO
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Tickeron AI dug through Chase Coleman's latest Tiger Global 13F and  
found a few surprises. Nvidia $NVDA is now the $2.74B top holding  
after they added 7.15%, and they opened a fresh $237M Ferrari $RACE  
stake. They almost wiped out Spotify $SPOT, cutting it 99.78%, while  
adding 48.26% to Cerebras $CBRS and 178.25% to Danaher $DHR. On the  
other side, they slashed Alphabet $GOOGL by 42.31%, TSMC $TSM by  
35.79% and Sea $SE by 43.41%.

Core Scientific $CORZ. They also cut Spotify $SPOT by 99.78%, leaving  
about $1M.  
  
Holdings as of Sep 30, 2026, per the Q3 13F filing. 13Fs cover long  
U.S.-listed positions only and lag the market — funds may have changed  
these since then. Tiger Global reported 45 positions worth $20.2B.
